en.title: European Disability Card Directive Advances as Delegated Act Adopted
en.summary: The European Commission adopted the Delegated Act on the European Disability Card Directive, adding technical details to the legislation. In related news, Allyable secured TX-RAMP certification to expand secure digital accessibility solutions in Texas, and NYU Langone researchers unveiled AI-powered tools to improve accessibility for blind individuals. Additionally, cities are rolling out accessibility upgrades and reports highlight ongoing shortages of accessible rooms for travelers with disabilities in Japan.

highlights.title: Delegated Act on the European Disability Card Directive adopted
Allyable Achieves TX-RAMP Certification, Expanding Secure Digital Accessibility Solutions for Texas Organizations
NYU Langone researchers build AI-powered tools to improve accessibility for blind people - CBS News
City responds to neighborhood safety concerns, outlines accessibility upgrades
Shortage of Accessible Rooms for Inbound Travelers in Japan

zh-TW.title: 歐洲殘疾人卡指令授權法案通關，德州及全球無障礙進展
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲委員會於7月1日發布歐洲殘疾人卡指令的授權法案最終文本，為立法添加技術細節。同時，Allyable 取得 TX-RAMP 認證，擴展德州組織的安全數位無障礙解決方案；紐約大學朗格尼醫學中心開發 AI 工具協助盲人改善無障礙體驗。各地亦推出無障礙升級，並有報告指出日本入境殘障旅客仍面臨無障礙客房不足的問題。

highlights.title: 歐洲殘疾人卡指令的授權法案已被採納
